Description: Rotated rectangles can be drawn by specifying rotation_angle values in NvOSD_RectParams in metadata.
The object can be blurred according to the parameters configured.

Feature: Supports drawing arrows, lines, circles, text in GPU mode
Description: Fill metadata as described in below rows to draw different shapes. (Alpha)
Arrows can be drawn by specifying values in NvOSD_ArrowParams in metadata.
Circles can be drawn by specifying values in NvOSD_CircleParams in metadata.
Blending boxes can be drawn by specifying bg_color values in NvOSD_RectParams in metadata.
Lines can be drawn by specifying values in NvOSD_LineParams in metadata.

Feature: Supports drawing text using Pango and Cairo libraries
Description: Text can be drawn by specifying values in NvOSD_TextParams in metadata.

Feature:
CPU mode and GPU support for drawing bounding boxes.
Setting opacity for bounding box borders is not supported in gpu mode.
Description: Bounding boxes can be drawn by specifying values in NvOSD_RectParams in metadata.
